basis: For each kind of birth, P(r) = sum a[j] binom(r,j) in absolute round r.
late_fit: Through the final D rounds; checked backward until the preceding mismatch.

descriptions.exact: All coefficients for every kind of birth.
descriptions.support: Only the kinds with a nonzero polynomial.
descriptions.degrees: The degree for each kind, including degree zero.
descriptions.constants_and_growing: The exact value of each constant. Every other count is called growing.
descriptions.constants_and_degrees: The exact constants and the degrees of the growing counts.
descriptions.constants_and_leading_coefficients: The degree and highest nonzero coefficient for each kind.
descriptions.all_differences: Coefficients of orders one and higher for each kind; ignores every constant term.
descriptions.constants_and_all_growing_differences: Exact constant counts and all coefficients above order zero for each growing count.

nested: In each round of a suffix through the last common round, either multiset contains the other. The direction may vary. A nonempty such suffix exists exactly when the last common multisets are nested.
weighting: One per census start, one per distinct unordered pair within each class. Reference comparisons include the reference itself when present.
scope: Each phase and dimension separately. Both references have dimension two. Reference comparisons in other dimensions are descriptive only.
